  "number": 82,
  "title": "Visual e2e: manage Clerk test users with Playwright fixtures",
  "body": "## Problem

Visual Playwright specs create ephemeral Clerk `+clerk_test` users (`codetail+{timestamp}-{label}-clerk_test@example.com`, `private_metadata.createdBy: e2e-visual-admin`) during seed/`beforeAll`, but **Docker/CI deliberately skips Clerk teardown**.

`shouldResetVisualSeeds()` in `e2e/visual/_helpers.ts` returns `false` when `VISUAL_DOCKER=1` or `CI` is set, so every `afterAll` that calls `deleteClerkTestUser` / `resetAdminClerkUsers` / `resetHostClerkUsers` is a no-op in the canonical runner.

Over repeated Visual CI runs this fills the Clerk free-tier user quota and fails user creation (`createClerkTestUser`), which recently blocked CI until users were batch-deleted by hand.

Convex seed state can stay disposable under anonymous local Convex; **Clerk users are not disposable** — they live on the shared Clerk instance.

## Goal

Implement Clerk (and related) user **setup + cleanup with Playwright fixtures** so teardown always runs for Clerk users — including Docker/CI — without relying on per-spec `beforeAll`/`afterAll` that opt out via `shouldResetVisualSeeds()`.

## Proposed approach

1. **Playwright fixture(s)** (worker- or test-scoped) that:
   - create labeled `+clerk_test` users (reuse `createClerkTestUser` / `VISUAL_ADMIN_CLERK_MARKER`)
   - expose `{ userId, email, … }` to the test/seed
   - **always** `deleteClerkTestUser` in fixture teardown (`finally`), independent of `shouldResetVisualSeeds()`
2. Prefer fixture-owned lifecycle over duplicated `afterAll` cleanup in each of:
   - `e2e/visual/admin.spec.ts`
   - `e2e/visual/host.spec.ts`
   - `e2e/visual/player.spec.ts`
   - `e2e/visual/solo-play.spec.ts`
   - `e2e/visual/ingest.spec.ts`
   - `e2e/visual/chrome.spec.ts`
3. Keep Convex DB reset skippable in Docker/CI (anonymous deploy is ephemeral); **do not** skip Clerk user deletion.
4. Optional hardening:
   - worker-scoped shared users where safe (fewer creates)
   - `globalTeardown` / safety-net sweep of `createdBy: e2e-visual-admin` older than N minutes if a run is killed mid-suite
   - fail fast with a clear quota error if create returns Clerk capacity errors

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Clerk test users created for visual specs are deleted after the suite/worker finishes in **local host**, **Docker**, and **CI**
- [ ] `shouldResetVisualSeeds()` no longer gates Clerk deletion (Convex-only concern)
- [ ] Repeated `pnpm test:visual:docker` / Visual workflow runs do not accumulate `codetail+*-clerk_test@example.com` users
- [ ] Specs use fixtures instead of ad-hoc create/delete where practical; existing seed helpers can still create users if fixtures own teardown
- [ ] Documented in `e2e/README.md`

## Context / refs

- Recent quota incident: batch-deleted 96 leftover visual users to unblock CI
- Create/delete helpers: `e2e/seed/_clerk-auth.ts`
- Skip flag: `e2e/visual/_helpers.ts` → `shouldResetVisualSeeds()`
- Docs today: `e2e/README.md` (“Docker / CI … skips afterAll seed + Clerk teardown”)
",
  "state": "closed",
  "user": {

  }
}
